scope: inference-time search only; no retraining; no architecture change

fixed_model.role: TTM table-B 'ours' row (slot0clean nmv2matched noq full, Stage 2 200k ema_final)
fixed_model.renders: eval.py verbatim through runpy; only MeanAudio.ode_wrapper / MeanFlow.run_t0_to_t1 are monkeypatched, and only for configs that change them

objective.audio: lvl30: per-clip scalar gain to -30.0 LUFS, peak_cap 0.999, PCM_16 flac (scripts/eval/level_match_rescore.py)
objective.why_lvl30: CLAP rises with playback level (063); lvl30 removes level as a free lever while keeping every trial and every baseline on the same rendering path

baseline_numbers_lvl30_dev256.note: derived from the canonical full cells by selecting the first 256 ids; no new generation; the other two checkpoints are extracted the same way in Phase 0

splits.rule: contiguous csv-record slices of the canonical MusicCaps TSV; no shuffling; no reuse of older subset files

dev256.note: first 256 records of dev1024; rung-1 screening set

splits.selection_rule: dev only (dev256 then dev1024); heldout1024 never used to choose a config; rest3473 only appears inside full-5521 reporting

rng_pairing.property: eval.py generates one row at a time (generate_mf([prompt], ...)), so a contiguous-prefix TSV reproduces the canonical full run's x0 bit-exactly for those rows
rng_pairing.consequence: rungs 1-3 and 5 are per-clip paired against the canonical baseline at the same checkpoint; rung 4 is a two-sample comparison with sigma*sqrt(2)

noise_floor.confidence_note: 0.0003 is the measured |delta| of one seed pair (memory reference_inference_seed_noise_floor); treated as ~1 sigma, which is conservative for CLAP

checkpoint_spread_lvl30_clap.note: 3 checkpoints, full 5521; this is model-to-model spread, not inference noise

noise_floor.measured_floor_rule: sigma_used = max(sigma_seed_by_n[n], |delta CLAP of C1_null_seed7|, |delta CLAP of C2_null_seed161803|); both null controls are in the rung-1 grid

thresholds.min_effect_source: 12.5% of the stock cfg3-cfg0 gap (+0.040); 3.6 sigma at n=256, 7.1 sigma at n=1024
thresholds.promotion_rung1: delta >= 0.005 on dev256 AND all rung-1 gates pass; top 8, at most 2 per family; if fewer than 3 pass, take the top 3 even if below threshold and mark the round underpowered
thresholds.promotion_rung2: delta >= 0.005 on dev1024 AND paired bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0 (10000 resamples, seed 20261027)
thresholds.promotion_rung3: best combo, or best single if no combo beats it by >= 0.002
thresholds.adoption: must pass rung 4 (heldout) and rung 5 (full, 3 checkpoints) per win_criterion

multiplicity.bias_note: rungs 1-3 deltas are upward-biased by selection; only heldout1024 (never used for selection) gives an unbiased estimate; full5521 contains 2048 records that were used for selection, so the full-set number is a paper number, not an independent test

prompt_leakage_audit.rule: no negative-prompt string may be a case-insensitive substring of any dev caption; prompts are hand-specified here and may not be mined from captions

rejected_candidate.reason: appears inside 240 dev captions; dropped before registration

prompts.stock: low quality recording, noisy, amateur, distorted, muffled, poor fidelity, hiss, lo-fi
prompts.extended: low quality recording, noisy, amateur, distorted, muffled, poor fidelity, hiss, lo-fi, clipping, room noise

families.F1_cfg_scale: cfg in {0.0,1.5,2.0,2.5,3.5,4.0,5.0}; stock prompt; 25 steps; uniform grid; 7 configs
families.F2_negative_prompt: 7 registered prompts at cfg 3.0; 25 steps; uniform grid
families.F3_guidance_interval: guidance on only when lo < t <= hi at cfg 3.0; off steps take the conditional-only branch; 6 intervals
families.F4_guidance_schedule: c(t) = 1 + 2*r(t) with r in {1-t, t, 4t(1-t), sqrt(1-t)}; never below 1; 4 configs
families.F5_geometry: ADG gamma in {0.25,0.5,1.0} (ref A, global axis); APG eta in {0.0,0.5,1.0}; cfg 3.0; 6 configs (apg_e1.0 is a numeric control of the patch path)
families.F6_steps: num_steps in {12,16,50}; cfg 3.0; stock prompt; 3 configs
families.F7_time_grid: grid in {cos, smoothstep} at 25 steps; cfg 3.0; stock prompt; 2 configs
families.C_controls: C0 duplicate of stock (seed 42, must match canonical audio bit-exactly); C1/C2 stock config at seeds 7 and 161803 (inference-seed noise floor)

G0_copy_gate.rule: stock config on dev256 at seed 42 must reproduce the canonical full-cell flac sha256 for all 256 ids

G1_determinism.rule: C0_dup_seed42 must reproduce the canonical flac sha256 for all 256 ids

G2_fad.note: at rung 1 a config failing only G2 may be carried as FAD-pending (max 2 slots); final adoption still requires G2 at rung 5

G3_pq.rule: AES PQ(lvl30 trial) - AES PQ(lvl30 baseline) < -0.10 -> not adopted
G3_pq.note: 0.10 is 0.7x the inference-seed PQ floor 0.142, so the gate can only fire on a real degradation

G4_silence.why: CLAP scores pure silence above 39% of music (065); silence escape is the cheapest way to game CLAP

G5_clipping.rule: raw level_clipped_n(trial) > baseline -> reject; raw crest_mean(trial) < baseline - 0.5 -> reject
G5_clipping.why: high-cfg saturation (2026-04-21 incident); crest is the waveform-collapse readout

G6_loudness.rule: lvl30 gain_status peak_capped_n > max(baseline+3, 0.005*n) -> reject; |LUFS + 30| > 0.05 on > 1% of clips -> reject
G6_loudness.why: if level matching fails, CLAP's level sensitivity contaminates the objective

G7_integrity.rule: all metrics finite; audio count == n; ids match the split exactly; no duplicate ids

G8_prompt_leak.rule: any registered prompt that is a substring of a dev caption is removed before the run (audit passes now)

rung4_requirements: mean delta lvl30 CLAP over 9 cells >= +0.004
checkpoint means positive at >= 2 of 3 checkpoints
seed means positive at all 3 seeds
G2/G3/G4/G5/G6/G7 pass on the heldout subset at the primary checkpoint
rung5_requirements: full 5521, seed 42, 3 checkpoints: mean delta lvl30 CLAP >= +0.005
G2 (FAD <= +0.30 vs the same-checkpoint cfg3 baseline), G3, G4, G5, G6, G7 all pass

claim_rules.checkpoint_specific: rung5 mean passes but < 2/3 checkpoints positive -> report as checkpoint-specific, not adopted
claim_rules.no_replication: rung4 fails -> report as not replicated, regardless of dev deltas
claim_rules.gate_fail: any mandated gate fails -> not adopted even if CLAP rises

win_criterion.reporting: raw CLAP, lvl30 CLAP, AES CE/CU/PC/PQ (raw and lvl30), level (LUFS/RMS/crest/silent/clipped), FAD (full, 1924 pairs, --ref_dir /mnt/HDD/kojiek/musiccaps_reference), MEva (heldout1024, pinned f03 binding)

measured_cost_model.scoring_scope: rungs 1-4 score raw level only plus the full lvl30 cell; rung 5 adds raw CLAP/AES and MEva

stages.work: copy gate, FAD parity, split baseline scoring, noise calibration
9 trials on heldout1024 (3 ckpt x 3 seeds)
3 full-5521 runs + FAD + MEva on heldout

early_stop: E1 rung 1: no config passes G2/G4-G7 with delta >= 0.005 -> stop and report a null result
E2 rung 2: no config reaches delta >= 0.005 with CI lower > 0 -> stop
E3 rung 3: no combo beats the best single by >= 0.002 -> go to rung 4 with the best single
E4 rung 4: winner fails the heldout requirements -> stop, report not replicated
E5 wall clock > 8 h at a rung boundary -> skip rung 3; > 15 h -> abort after the current trial
E6 rung 5 gate failure -> report the gate failure, do not claim a win

disk.retained_per_trial: summary.json, per_clip.tsv, metrics.json (raw and lvl30), gain_status.tsv, fad.json; audio deleted after scoring
later_move_candidates_not_moved_this_rou: /home/kojiek/eval_output_nvme (110 GB) -> /mnt/seagate/nvme_archive/eval_output_nvme, keeping the six canonical full cells

loop.mechanism: hybrid: one direct phase, then one queue job per rung with an agent audit between rungs
loop.phase0: direct run (<30 min) with gpu0.lock via hold_lock.py and notify_on_exit; reason: contract overhead exceeds the work
loop.queue_jobs: p2, numbering after 152, contract in docs/experiments/ before the launcher enters pending/, no dotfiles in pending/
loop.between_rungs: run analyze.py, write round{N+1}_configs.json + contract, commit, stage launcher, submit
loop.resume: trial-level: a trial whose summary.json exists and whose config sha matches is skipped

predictions: P1 F2 (prompt) is the strongest family: the short prompt (low quality recording, noisy) beats stock on lvl30 CLAP by +0.003 to +0.010, because 086/108 showed the single strongest term carries most of the gain
P2 the CLAP-vs-cfg curve is flat within 0.003 between 2.5 and 4.0 and falls at 5.0
P3 guidance restricted to the first third (t > 0.667) keeps >= 80% of the stock CLAP and raises PQ by >= 0.05, matching the 075 finding that 93-100% of the gain happens in the first 9/25 steps
P4 ADG/APG at cfg 3.0 are within 0.003 of vanilla on lvl30 CLAP (073: norm waste is only 2% of the fidelity gain)
P5 all three controls stay within 0.002 of baseline on dev256 and C0 reproduces the canonical flac sha256 exactly
P6 the final winner is a prompt or interval change worth +0.004 to +0.012 lvl30 CLAP on full 5521; if it survives heldout it is a real, reportable effect
P7 probability that some config passes every gate including heldout: about 40%; the most likely failure mode is a dev-only gain that does not replicate on heldout
P8 FAD and PQ gates will reject at least one high-CLAP config, because CLAP and fidelity have moved in opposite directions in earlier lines (064, 084)
risks: CLAP batch-1 on lvl30 audio is a new scale; all comparisons must stay inside this prereg and not be mixed with raw CLAP numbers
FAD on 256/1024-clip subsets is noisy; the noise is measured from three baseline checkpoints on the same subset before any gate is enforced
the 3-checkpoint confirmation uses checkpoints that are already on disk; a checkpoint that is not bit-identical to the registered sha invalidates the confirmation
any change to eval.py, eval_metrics.py, mc_mf25_eval.sh or level_match_rescore.py invalidates this prereg
